owner_authorization.verbatim: Approve GIT-REMOTE-2026-001 option A and proceed
owner_authorization.interpretation: Approve the recoverable history rewrite described as option A in GIT-REMOTE-2026-001.

authorized_operations: Create and verify a local full-history Git recovery bundle before rewriting.
Remove infra/.terraform/** from every commit reachable from local master using git-filter-repo.
Record the complete old-to-new commit map and a content-addressed migration receipt.
Verify the sanitized history, rerun canonical tests and reproduce the deterministic B5 refusal outcome.
Push sanitized master to the existing private GitHub repository and make master the default branch.
Verify the result through remote-ref inspection and a fresh clone.
prohibited_operations: Intentionally alter historical file contents outside infra/.terraform/**.
Expose GitHub credentials in command output, repository content or evidence.
Execute AWS packet 2026-001B or modify AWS, production SSM, registered models, approved artifacts or deployments.
